<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Sales" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approved"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales and Customer Support" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_Approval" name="Quote approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved" messageRef="Msg_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_Confirmation" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and Order Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect information and address concerns"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Process ended without order"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Guide selection of product or service"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproved" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_Approval" messageRef="Msg_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states a conditional choice whose alternative outcomes later reconverge on a shared next activity or on an end event, while one branch leaves the process early: Model an exclusive gateway at the split for the conditional choice, with one labeled outgoing flow per outcome. Where the alternative paths come together again before a shared next activity or end event, insert a separate exclusive gateway as the merge point, so that each path enters the common step through a gateway rather than through a direct flow from several branches. Keep an early-exit branch as its own path to an end event instead of merging it into the continuing flow.
rules.situation: the description states a conditional choice whose alternative outcomes later reconverge on a shared next activity or on an end event, while one branch leaves the process early

rules.instruction: When the description states that a later step happens only if a condition about the customer holds, and the condition is stated before that step: Place an exclusive gateway with a conditional branch immediately before the first activity that depends on that condition, so that no dependent activity is reached before the decision. Do not place the decision after later activities that do not depend on it. The branch that fails the condition should lead to a separate path or end.
rules.situation: the description states that a later step happens only if a condition about the customer holds, and the condition is stated before that step

rules.instruction: When the description states one sentence in which a performer or performer group carries out two distinct activities joined by 'and', where the second activity responds to or resolves issues raised by the first: Model each of the two activities as its own task, in the order stated in the sentence, connected by a sequence flow. Do not merge them into one task whose label combines both actions, and do not drop either activity from the model.
rules.situation: the description states one sentence in which a performer or performer group carries out two distinct activities joined by 'and', where the second activity responds to or resolves issues raised by the first

rules.instruction: When the description opens with an action taken by an external party (for example, a customer making an inquiry) and then describes the organization's own work in response to it: Model a start event for the external occurrence that triggers the process, with no incoming flow. Model the organization's first response to that occurrence as a separate task placed after the start event, and do not name the start event after the work the organization performs.
rules.situation: the description opens with an action taken by an external party (for example, a customer making an inquiry) and then describes the organization's own work in response to it
